vb_textbox.text: I started off quite random until I got the hang of the game.  I then picked the left or right gnome depending on the outcome that I got when I clicked at what I thought was the same amount of time each time.I would select the left hand gnome (S) and then take a breath which was then enough for me t press the space bar - if I scored lower after 2 or 3 times in doing this, I would then switch gnomes.Where I scored around 8 or 9 in a row, I would continue with the chosen gnome until the score dropped again, then switch it over
